title: Canonical config-flake input URL (Phase-5 decision)
description:
Objective: adopt a pinned `github:georgrybski/workestrate` (or `github:georgrybski/ai-workbench`) input for the personal config repo's `workestrate` flake input once the push state is confirmed, replacing the host-absolute `git+file:///home/rybski/Development/agent-workbench/workestrate` workaround committed in the host-boot fix pass (2026-08-03).

Background: the personal config repo flake.nix previously pointed at `git+file:///home/node/Development/agent-workbench/workestrate` — a container-only path unusable on the host. The immediate fix repoints it to the host path `git+file:///home/rybski/...` (relock required on host). The canonical long-term fix is a pinned `github:` input, which is portable across machines and survives a clean nix copy-to-store. This is deferred to Phase 5 because it requires the tool repo's origin/migration/tool-model branch to be pushed to the remote first.

Push-state check (host): run `git -C <workestrate-checkout> fetch && git log --oneline origin/migration/tool-model..HEAD` to confirm whether the local HEAD (ddff1a0 + the host-boot fix commits) is pushed. If unpushed commits exist, push before adopting the github: input, then relock with `nix flake lock --update-input workestrate` on the host.

Supersedes: the `git+file:///home/rybski/...` host-path workaround (a Phase-5 decision will retire it). Related spec: 21-image-build-lifecycle.md (the config-flake input is what makes the nix-layered image builds reproducible across machines — see §10 phased plan and §12.3 migration notes).

title: Revisit short_msb_home / KVM-test MSB_HOME convention for a more idiomatic approach
description: Objective: the short_msb_home() fixed-/tmp helper + the MSB_HOME-vs-HOME decoupling in the two KVM tests (lifecycle_detached.rs, ensure_images_e2e.rs) is a pragmatic workaround for the 108-byte unix-socket limit (MSB_HOME/run/agent/<32hex>.sock = len+48 < 108 => len(MSB_HOME) <= 59). Brainstorm a more idiomatic long-term approach and refactor. Options: (a) msb supporting a configurable run/socket dir via paths.sandboxes (or equivalent) so the socket path is independent of MSB_HOME depth; (b) a canonical short-MSB_HOME test convention surfaced as a first-class test-support helper with a documented contract, rather than a /tmp literal in two KVM tests. Either path lets the KVM tests return to the temp_dir() idiom and removes the /tmp divergence (documented on the helper). Acceptance: a chosen approach is recorded, the /tmp literal is removed or justified, and the KVM tests still pass on a HOST-KVM host. Environment: HOST-KVM (validation) + verifiable-here (refactor). Blocker: none — pure QOL/follow-up. See spec 21 §14 (docs/validation-and-improvements/06-improvements/21-image-build-lifecycle.md).
